select T1.TRADE_MARKET, T2.TYPE_8, case when T2.TYPE_8 ='F01' then T2.TYPE_6 else null end AS TYPE_6, case when T2.TYPE_8 ='F01' then T2.TYPE_7
else null end AS TYPE_7, case when T2.TYPE_8 = 'F11' then T3.BOARD else null end AS BOARD FROM FIN_PRODUCT T1 LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE T2 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T2.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD T3 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T3.FINPROD_ID WHERE T1.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId}

SELECT T.COUNTER_ID "counterId", T1.LINK_ID "linkId", T1.COUNTER_TYPE "counterType", T1.COUNTER_NAME "counterName", T.COUNTER_SEAT_ID "counterSeatId" FROM MST_COUNTER_PARTY_INFO T INNER JOIN MST_COUNTER_PARTY T1 ON T.COUNTER_ID = T1.COUNTER_ID
T.COUNTER_SEAT_ID IS NOT NULL
AND T.COUNTER_ID = #{counterId}
AND T.COUNTER_SEAT_ID like concat('%',concat(#{counterSeatId,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%'))

SELECT T.COUNTER_ID "counterId", T1.LINK_ID "linkId", T1.COUNTER_TYPE "counterType", T1.COUNTER_NAME "counterName", T.COUNTER_TRADER_ID "counterTraderId" FROM MST_COUNTER_PARTY_INFO T LEFT JOIN MST_COUNTER_PARTY T1 ON T.COUNTER_ID = T1.COUNTER_ID
T.COUNTER_TRADER_ID IS NOT NULL
AND T.COUNTER_ID = #{counterId}
AND T.COUNTER_ID != 'homeTrader'
AND T.COUNTER_TRADER_ID like concat('%',concat(#{counterTraderId,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%'))

SELECT T.FINPROD_MARKET_ID innerCode, T.TRADE_MARKET market, T.FINPROD_MARKET_ID stockCode, T.FINPROD_ABBR stockName, T2.TYPE_8 assetType, CASE WHEN T2.TYPE_8 = 'F11' THEN '' ELSE T2.TYPE_6 END assetType1, CASE WHEN T2.TYPE_8 = 'F01' THEN T3.parValue ELSE null END parValue, CASE WHEN T2.TYPE_8 = 'F11' THEN T1.BOARD
ELSE T2.TYPE_7 END subStockType, T1.IS_NETPRICE netPricFlag, T1.TRADE_PLAT tradePlat,
null contractMultiplier, T1.ETF_TYPE etfType, T1.TRM_FUND_TYPE trmFundType, T1.PUR_RED_ID purRedId, T1.PUR_RED_ABBR purRedAbbr FROM FIN_PRODUCT T INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD T1 ON T.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE T2 ON T.FINPROD_ID = T2.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT nvl(100 - sum(nvl(PRIN_AMT, 0)), 100) parValue, FINPROD_ID FROM FIN_CASH_PLAN WHERE MDATE <= #{platDate,jdbcType=DATE} GROUP BY FINPROD_ID ) T3 ON T.FINPROD_ID = T3.FINPROD_ID WHERE T.TRADE_MARKET IN (#{TRADE_MARKET_03,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{TRADE_MARKET_04,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AND T2.TYPE_8 IN (#{ASSET_TYPE_F01,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{ASSET_TYPE_F02,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{ASSET_TYPE_F11,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{ASSET_TYPE_F20,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
AND T.TRADE_MARKET = #{market,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND T.FINPROD_MARKET_ID like concat('%',concat(#{stock_code,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%'))
union all SELECT T.FINPROD_ID innerCode, T.TRADE_MARKET market, T.FINPROD_ID stockCode, T.FINPROD_ID stockName, 'F07' assetType, CASE WHEN T.FINPROD_TYPE2 ='F02' THEN '03' ELSE '04' END assetType1, null subStockType, null netPricFlag, null tradePlat, null parValue, null contractMultiplier, null etfType, null trmFundType, null purRedId, null purRedAbbr FROM FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT T WHERE T.TRADE_MARKET IN (#{TRADE_MARKET_03,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{TRADE_MARKET_04,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AND T.FINPROD_TYPE2 IN (#{FINPROD_TYPE_F02,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{FINPROD_TYPE_F03,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
AND T.TRADE_MARKET = #{market,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND T.FINPROD_ID like concat('%',concat(#{stock_code,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%'))
select T1.TRADE_MARKET, T1.TERM_TYPE FROM MST_REPO_PRODUCT T1 WHERE T1.MARKET_ID = #{finprodId}
select count(1) from FIN_EXERCISE_PLAN where FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} and EXERCISE_DATE > = #{sysDate,jdbcType=DATE} and EXERCISE_TYPE in ('01','02')
